cases.title: Search with Empty Input Triggers Error Toast
cases.description: Verify that clicking the search button with an empty search input field displays the error toast with the correct message.

cases.title: Search with Valid Input Fetches and Displays Word Details
cases.description: Verify that entering a valid word and clicking the search button displays the result card containing the title, pronunciation, meaning, and example.

cases.title: Reset Button Clears Input and Hides Result Card
cases.description: Verify that clicking the reset button clears the search input field and hides the result card regardless of prior state.

cases.title: Toggle Bookmark Status and Update Offcanvas List
cases.description: Verify that clicking the bookmark icon on a result card updates its status and adds the word to the bookmarked words list in the offcanvas section.

cases.title: Maintain Recent Searches List up to Five Entries
cases.description: Verify that performing searches updates the 'Recent Searches' section and keeps a maximum of five entries by removing the oldest.

cases.title: Back to Top Button Visibility and Functionality
cases.description: Verify that scrolling down more than 20 pixels reveals the 'Back to Top' button and clicking it smoothly scrolls the page to the top.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all provided requirements comprehensively with distinct scenarios and no blockers identified.
All cases are clear, well-grounded in the requirements, and fully testable. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: R-2: Testable behavior: Empty search input triggers error toast. Boundaries: Empty vs valid search input. Normal path: Input empty, click search-button -> error-toast appears with 'ERROR: Please type the word to be searched...'. Abnormal path: Valid word, click search -> no error toast. Ambiguities: Definition of 'valid word' against API response. R-3: Testable behavior: Fetch and display word details. Normal path: Enter word, click search-button -> result-card appears with card-title, word-pronunciation, word-meaning, word-example from API. Abnormal path: Invalid API word. Ambiguities: API failure handling behavior. R-4: Testable behavior: Reset functionality. Normal path: Click reset-button -> clears search-input and hides result-card. Boundaries: Works when input is empty or has text, before or after search. R-5: Testable behavior: Toggle bookmark status. Normal path: Click bookmark-icon on result-card updates icon and adds to bookmarked-words-list in offcanvas via bookmark-button. Abnormal path: Toggling off removes from list. R-8: Testable behavior: Recent searches list maintenance. Normal path: Perform search -> adds to recently-searched. Boundaries: Maximum of 5 entries; oldest removed when exceeding 5. R-9: Testable behavior: Back to Top button visibility and scroll action. Normal path: Scroll > 20px -> back-to-top-button displays; click -> smoothly scrolls to top and hides. Boundaries: Exactly at 20px vs > 20px. R-10: Testable behavior: Manage bookmarks in offcanvas. Normal path: Click bookmark-button -> opens offcanvas with bookmarked-words-list. Click bookmark-delete-button-${index} removes word and updates list. Abnormal path: No bookmarks shows <h5> 'No words bookmarked !!'.
